name: @red-cup-engineering/urn-engineering-services-section
description: Groups the firm's RFC 8141 Uniform Resource Name services: admission of a surface string into its NID/NSS/r-component/q-component/f-component parts, rendering admitted parts back into a URN string, and RFC 8141 URN-equivalence of two URNs. Generic and RFC-faithful only; carries no firm-specific naming semantics.
